feeds.title: Nordiclarp.org
feeds.description: Articles on LARP, production, inspirations, and ideas for magical LARP experience and more! Nordiclarp.org is an Online magazine about Nordic-style LARP.

feeds.title: LARP News
feeds.description: Find the latest news and updates from the LARP community with popular LARPs, tips, and more! News site reporting about live-action roleplay (LARP) events and all things related.

feeds.title: Fair Escape
feeds.description: This blog is intended to be a collection of thoughts on my favorite hobby, along with a record of my personal experiences in LARPing. If anything, I hope this blog might help kickstart interesting conversations about LARP, and give people a glimpse of some of what goes on in the New England LARP communities. I've been LARPing for years, in a variety of styles, including both live combat and theater.

feeds.title: LarpHack
feeds.description: The definitive Calendar and Guide to Sport LARPing in New England - encompassing reviews, tips, tricks, and solutions to any sort of adventure that can be found. I have been gaming since I was about 6, starting in the golden day of tabletops and lead miniatures. Experienced in strategy games, writing, adventure campaigns, I've been LARPing for over 16 years - and more importantly, have game experience in almost 40 LARP game systems over hundreds of events.

feeds.title: LARPed Blog
feeds.description: From fantasy to horror, take a look at some LARPs on our radar, and see if they might be for you. While some might involve boffer combat, others are political and heavy role-play. LARPed is a resource for LARPers, those who play role-playing games and people looking to get into the nerd scene and experience the amazing world of live-action role-play. We're a group of dedicated larpers putting out content, tutorials, tips, tricks, and resources for other larpers of every skill and talent level.
